Waits until a path exists, a service is running or a TCP port is listening on a Windows host. Refresh checks again, so a later apply waits again if it stopped.

Use `windows_wait_for` to pause a circuit until a path exists, a service is running or a TCP port is listening on a Windows host. It keeps trying through a reboot, so it's the natural step to follow `windows_reboot`.

## Example usage

```hcl
step "web_up" {
  windows_wait_for {
    service = "W3SVC"
    timeout = "10m"
  }
}
```

```hcl
step "app_listening" {
  windows_wait_for {
    port = 8080
  }
}
```

```hcl
step "app_ready" {
  windows_wait_for {
    path    = "C:\\app\\ready"
    timeout = "1m"
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | No | Path to wait for, such as C:\app\ready. Set exactly one of path, service and port. |
| `port` | number | No | TCP port to wait for a listener on. Set exactly one of path, service and port. |
| `service` | string | No | Name of a service to wait for until it is running. Set exactly one of path, service and port. |
| `timeout` | string | No | How long to wait. Defaults to "5m". |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_windows_wait_for.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `in_sync` | bool | Whether it was ready at the last refresh. |
| `revision` | string | Changes each time Conn3x changes this on the host. Handlers watch it. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_windows_wait_for` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.

## How it works

**Waiting.** Conn3x checks every two seconds, and fails the step if it isn't ready after `timeout`, which defaults to `"5m"`. Each check starts PowerShell in a new session. If the host can't be reached yet, that counts as not ready.

**Reading.** Every plan checks again. If the path is gone, the service stopped or nothing listens on the port any more, the plan shows the step out of sync and the next apply waits again.

**Validation.** Set exactly one of `path`, `service` and `port`. `path` must be a drive-letter or UNC path.

## Removal

Deleting a `windows_wait_for` step does nothing on the host.
